name: Virginia ~Hontou no Sekai~
original_name: バージニア ～真実の未来～
source:
Main character is a captain of knights returning with his subordinates to their kingdom after winning a tournament. Their vehicle gets attacked on the way while horizon gets dyed with fire. What's happened to their kingdom during their absence?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名骑士团长，在赢得比武大会后，率领部下返回自己的王国。途中，他们乘坐的车辆遭到袭击，地平线也被火焰染红。他们离开期间，王国究竟发生了什么？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
